spec.rawSql:
SELECT * FROM (
SELECT
    child_ou.id as child_id,
    child_ou.name as child_name,
    build_drill_url(child_ou.id) as drill_url,
    CASE WHEN child_ou.level >= 5 THEN
      '/d/heart360_facility?var-Region=' || COALESCE((SELECT lin2.ancestor_id::text FROM org_unit_lineage lin2 WHERE lin2.org_unit_id = child_ou.id AND lin2.ancestor_level = 1), '') ||
      '&var-District=' || COALESCE((SELECT lin2.ancestor_id::text FROM org_unit_lineage lin2 WHERE lin2.org_unit_id = child_ou.id AND lin2.ancestor_level = 2), '') ||
      '&var-Facility=' || COALESCE((SELECT lin2.ancestor_id::text FROM org_unit_lineage lin2 WHERE lin2.org_unit_id = child_ou.id AND lin2.ancestor_level = 3), '') ||
      '&var-Sub_Facility=' || COALESCE((SELECT lin2.ancestor_id::text FROM org_unit_lineage lin2 WHERE lin2.org_unit_id = child_ou.id AND lin2.ancestor_level = 4), '')
    ELSE NULL END as facility_url,
    SUM(COALESCE(uc.nb_patients_under_care, 0)) AS nb_patients_under_care,
    SUM(COALESCE(nb_new_patients, 0)) AS nb_patients_newly_registered,
    SUM(cat.nb_patients_controlled) AS nb_patients_controlled,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(cat.nb_patients_controlled) / NULLIF(GREATEST(0, SUM(cat.TOTAL_NUMBER_OF_PATIENTS) - SUM(cat.NB_PATIENTS_NEWLY_REGISTERED) - SUM(cat.NB_PATIENTS_LOST_TO_FOLLOW_UP)), 0)) AS per_patients_controlled,
    SUM(cat.nb_patients_uncontrolled) AS nb_patients_uncontrolled,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(cat.nb_patients_uncontrolled) / NULLIF(GREATEST(0, SUM(cat.TOTAL_NUMBER_OF_PATIENTS) - SUM(cat.NB_PATIENTS_NEWLY_REGISTERED) - SUM(cat.NB_PATIENTS_LOST_TO_FOLLOW_UP)), 0)) AS per_patients_uncontrolled,
    SUM(cat.nb_patients_no_visit) AS nb_patients_no_visit,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(cat.nb_patients_no_visit) / NULLIF(GREATEST(0, SUM(cat.TOTAL_NUMBER_OF_PATIENTS) - SUM(cat.NB_PATIENTS_NEWLY_REGISTERED) - SUM(cat.NB_PATIENTS_LOST_TO_FOLLOW_UP)), 0)) AS per_patients_no_visit
FROM HEART360_PATIENTS_CATEGORY cat
JOIN org_unit_lineage lin ON cat.org_unit_id = lin.org_unit_id
JOIN org_units child_ou ON lin.ancestor_id = child_ou.id
   AND ((NULLIF(NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0'), 'NULL') IS NULL AND child_ou.level = 1)
        OR child_ou.parent_id = NULLIF(NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0'), 'NULL')::integer)
LEFT JOIN heart360_patients_registered
    ON cat.ref_month = heart360_patients_registered.ref_month
    AND cat.org_unit_id = heart360_patients_registered.org_unit_id
LEFT JOIN HEART360_PATIENTS_UNDER_CARE uc
    ON cat.ref_month = uc.ref_month
    AND cat.org_unit_id = uc.org_unit_id
WHERE cat.ref_month = (
    SELECT MAX(ref_month) FROM HEART360_PATIENTS_CATEGORY
    WHERE org_unit_id IN (SELECT id FROM org_units
  WHERE NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0') IS NULL
  UNION
  SELECT id FROM get_descendant_ids(
    (SELECT ou.id FROM org_units ou
     WHERE ou.id::text = NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0')
     LIMIT 1)
  ))
    AND $__timeFilter(ref_month)
)
GROUP BY child_ou.id, child_ou.name, child_ou.level
ORDER BY child_ou.name
) AS master_access_control WHERE '${isAllowed}' = '1'

spec.rawSql:
-- Org unit tree scoped to the current user. Locations the user can view are enabled;
-- their ancestors are shown disabled so the hierarchy is kept without exposing data.
-- ${userAccess} = the user's locations as <org unit id>:<1 if patient-level access> (0 = All Locations).
WITH access AS (
  SELECT split_part(a, ':', 1)::int AS id
  FROM unnest(string_to_array(NULLIF('${userAccess}', ''), ',')) a
),
visible AS (
  SELECT lin.ancestor_id AS id
  FROM heart360tk_schema.org_unit_lineage lin
  JOIN access a ON a.id = lin.org_unit_id
)
SELECT 0 AS id, 'All Locations' AS name, 0 AS level, NULL::integer AS parent_id,
       0 NOT IN (SELECT id FROM access) AS disabled
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM visible)
UNION ALL
SELECT ou.id, ou.name, ou.level, COALESCE(ou.parent_id, 0) AS parent_id,
       ou.id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM access) AS disabled
FROM heart360tk_schema.org_units ou
WHERE ou.id IN (SELECT id FROM visible)
UNION ALL
-- Placeholder so the frame keeps its columns when nothing is visible; the panel's
-- "id is not null" transformation drops it.
SELECT NULL, 'No data', NULL, NULL, NULL WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM visible)
ORDER BY parent_id NULLS FIRST, name

monthly_data AS (

)

  nb_new_patients
FROM monthly_data

spec.rawSql:
SELECT * FROM (
WITH latest_month AS (
    SELECT MAX(ref_month) AS ref_month FROM HEART360_BLOOD_SUGAR_CONTROLLED
    WHERE org_unit_id IN (SELECT id FROM org_units
  WHERE NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0') IS NULL
  UNION
  SELECT id FROM get_descendant_ids(
    (SELECT ou.id FROM org_units ou
     WHERE ou.id::text = NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0')
     LIMIT 1)
  ))
    AND $__timeFilter(ref_month)
)
SELECT
    child_ou.id AS child_id,
    child_ou.name AS child_name,
    build_drill_url(child_ou.id) AS drill_url,
    SUM(COALESCE(uc.nb_dm_patients_under_care, 0)) AS nb_patients_under_care,
    SUM(COALESCE(uc.nb_new_dm_patients, 0)) AS nb_patients_newly_registered,
    SUM(COALESCE(bsc.diabetes_controlled, 0)) AS nb_patients_controlled,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(COALESCE(bsc.diabetes_controlled, 0)) / NULLIF(SUM(COALESCE(bsc.diabetes_patients_under_care, 0)), 0)) AS per_patients_controlled,
    SUM(COALESCE(bss.uncontrolled_moderate, 0) + COALESCE(bss.uncontrolled_high, 0)) AS nb_patients_uncontrolled,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(COALESCE(bss.uncontrolled_moderate, 0) + COALESCE(bss.uncontrolled_high, 0)) / NULLIF(SUM(COALESCE(bss.diabetes_patients_under_care, 0)), 0)) AS per_patients_uncontrolled,
    SUM(COALESCE(bsm.missed_visit, 0)) AS nb_patients_no_visit,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(COALESCE(bsm.missed_visit, 0)) / NULLIF(SUM(COALESCE(bsm.diabetes_patients_under_care, 0)), 0)) AS per_patients_no_visit
FROM org_unit_lineage lin
JOIN org_units child_ou ON lin.ancestor_id = child_ou.id AND child_ou.parent_id = ((SELECT ou.id FROM org_units ou WHERE ou.id::text = NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), '') LIMIT 1))
LEFT JOIN HEART360_DM_PATIENTS_UNDER_CARE uc ON uc.org_unit_id = lin.org_unit_id AND uc.ref_month = (SELECT ref_month FROM latest_month)
LEFT JOIN HEART360_BLOOD_SUGAR_CONTROLLED bsc ON bsc.org_unit_id = lin.org_unit_id AND bsc.ref_month = (SELECT ref_month FROM latest_month)
LEFT JOIN HEART360_BLOOD_SUGAR_SEVERITY bss ON bss.org_unit_id = lin.org_unit_id AND bss.ref_month = (SELECT ref_month FROM latest_month)
LEFT JOIN HEART360_BLOOD_SUGAR_MISSED_VISITS bsm ON bsm.org_unit_id = lin.org_unit_id AND bsm.ref_month = (SELECT ref_month FROM latest_month)
GROUP BY child_ou.id, child_ou.name
ORDER BY child_ou.name
) AS master_access_control WHERE '${isAllowed}' = '1'

spec.rawSql:
SELECT * FROM (
SELECT
  patient_id,
  patient_name,
  registration_date,
  birth_date,
  gender,
  phone_number,
  (SELECT name FROM org_units WHERE id = h.org_unit_id) AS facility,
  last_visit_date,
  last_bp_diastolic,
  last_bp_systolic,
  last_call_date,
  last_call_result AS result_type,
  COALESCE(removed_reason, '-') AS removed_reason,
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(birth_date)) AS age_years,
  to_char(registration_date, 'FMDD Mon, YYYY') AS registration_label,
  to_char(last_visit_date, 'FMDD Mon, YYYY')
    || CASE WHEN last_visit_date::time <> '00:00'
         THEN E'\n' || lower(to_char(last_visit_date, 'FMHH12:MI AM')) ELSE '' END AS last_visit_label,
  to_char(last_call_date, 'FMDD Mon, YYYY') AS last_contacted_label,
  (CURRENT_DATE - last_visit_date::date) AS days_since_last_visit,
  CASE
    WHEN last_bp_systolic IS NOT NULL AND last_bp_diastolic IS NOT NULL
      THEN CONCAT(
        last_bp_systolic::int,
        '/',
        last_bp_diastolic::int
      )
    ELSE NULL
  END AS last_bp
FROM HEART360_OVERDUE_PATIENTS h
WHERE org_unit_id IN (SELECT id FROM org_units
  WHERE NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0') IS NULL
  UNION
  SELECT id FROM get_descendant_ids(
    (SELECT ou.id FROM org_units ou
     WHERE ou.id::text = NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0')
     LIMIT 1)
  ))
  AND last_visit_date < now() - interval '45 days'
    AND ${selected_level} IN (3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10)
  AND COALESCE(current_setting('app.is_central_node', true), 'false') <> 'true'
ORDER BY (CURRENT_DATE - last_visit_date::date) DESC
) AS master_access_control WHERE '${isPatientsAllowed}' = '1'

order by sort

INSERT INTO call_results (patient_id, call_date, result_type, removed_reason, org_unit_id)
VALUES (
  '${payload.patient_id}',
  CURRENT_DATE,
  CASE
    WHEN '${payload.removed_reason}' IN ('Agreed to visit', 'Pending to call', 'Call again later')
      THEN NULL
    ELSE 'removed_from_overdue_list'
  END,
  '${payload.removed_reason}',
  (SELECT org_unit_id FROM patients WHERE patient_id='${payload.patient_id}' LIMIT 1)
)
ON CONFLICT (patient_id, call_date)
DO UPDATE SET
  result_type = EXCLUDED.result_type,
  removed_reason = EXCLUDED.removed_reason;

SELECT
  ref_month,
  SUM(nb_patients_controlled) AS controlled_n,
  SUM(nb_patients_uncontrolled) AS uncontrolled_n,
  SUM(nb_patients_no_visit) AS no_visit_n,
  GREATEST(0, SUM(TOTAL_NUMBER_OF_PATIENTS) - SUM(NB_PATIENTS_NEWLY_REGISTERED)
    - SUM(NB_PATIENTS_LOST_TO_FOLLOW_UP)) AS denominator_n
FROM HEART360_PATIENTS_CATEGORY
WHERE org_unit_id IN (SELECT id FROM org_units
  WHERE NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0') IS NULL
  UNION
  SELECT id FROM get_descendant_ids(
    (SELECT ou.id FROM org_units ou
     WHERE ou.id::text = NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0')
     LIMIT 1)
  ))
GROUP BY ref_month
ORDER BY ref_month

Dead patients and 12 month lost to follow-up patients are excluded. Figures are the latest completed month; the current month is dashed or faded.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT * FROM (
WITH ctl AS (
  SELECT ref_month, SUM(diabetes_controlled) AS controlled_n, SUM(diabetes_patients_under_care) AS denominator_n
  FROM HEART360_BLOOD_SUGAR_CONTROLLED WHERE org_unit_id IN (SELECT id FROM org_units
  WHERE NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0') IS NULL
  UNION
  SELECT id FROM get_descendant_ids(
    (SELECT ou.id FROM org_units ou
     WHERE ou.id::text = NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0')
     LIMIT 1)
  ))
  GROUP BY ref_month
), sev AS (
  SELECT ref_month, SUM(uncontrolled_moderate) AS moderate_n, SUM(uncontrolled_high) AS high_n
  FROM HEART360_BLOOD_SUGAR_SEVERITY WHERE org_unit_id IN (SELECT id FROM org_units
  WHERE NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0') IS NULL
  UNION
  SELECT id FROM get_descendant_ids(
    (SELECT ou.id FROM org_units ou
     WHERE ou.id::text = NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0')
     LIMIT 1)
  ))
  GROUP BY ref_month
), mv AS (
  SELECT ref_month, SUM(missed_visit) AS no_visit_n
  FROM HEART360_BLOOD_SUGAR_MISSED_VISITS WHERE org_unit_id IN (SELECT id FROM org_units
  WHERE NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0') IS NULL
  UNION
  SELECT id FROM get_descendant_ids(
    (SELECT ou.id FROM org_units ou
     WHERE ou.id::text = NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0')
     LIMIT 1)
  ))
  GROUP BY ref_month
)
SELECT ctl.ref_month, ctl.controlled_n, sev.moderate_n, sev.high_n, mv.no_visit_n, ctl.denominator_n
FROM ctl
LEFT JOIN sev ON sev.ref_month = ctl.ref_month
LEFT JOIN mv ON mv.ref_month = ctl.ref_month
ORDER BY ctl.ref_month
) AS master_access_control WHERE '${isAllowed}' = '1'

WITH sel AS (SELECT NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int AS id),
scope AS (SELECT id FROM get_descendant_ids((SELECT id FROM sel))),
m AS (SELECT (to_timestamp(${reference_month}/1000.0) - interval '1 month')::date AS mon),
ex AS (SELECT 2100000::numeric AS adults, 11.94::numeric AS prevalence_pct, 840000::numeric AS screened,
              75600::numeric AS raised, 41000::numeric AS linked, 18900::numeric AS diagnosed),
trt AS (
  SELECT
    (SELECT SUM(r.cumulative_number_of_patients) FROM heart360tk_reporting.heart360_patients_registered r, m
      WHERE r.ref_month = m.mon AND r.org_unit_id IN (SELECT id FROM scope)) AS registered,
    (SELECT SUM(r.cumulative_number_of_patients) FROM heart360tk_reporting.heart360_patients_registered r, m
      WHERE r.ref_month = m.mon) AS registered_all,
    (SELECT SUM(c.nb_patients_under_care) FROM heart360tk_reporting.heart360_patients_category c, m
      WHERE c.ref_month = m.mon AND c.org_unit_id IN (SELECT id FROM scope)) AS under_care,
    (SELECT SUM(c.nb_patients_controlled) FROM heart360tk_reporting.heart360_patients_category c, m
      WHERE c.ref_month = m.mon AND c.org_unit_id IN (SELECT id FROM scope)) AS controlled),
k AS (SELECT COALESCE(trt.registered / NULLIF(trt.registered_all, 0), 0) AS share FROM trt)
SELECT to_char(m.mon, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS reporting_month,
  (SELECT name FROM org_units WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM sel)) AS place,
  ROUND(ex.adults * k.share) AS adults, ex.prevalence_pct,
  ROUND(ex.adults * k.share * ex.prevalence_pct / 100) AS estimated,
  CASE WHEN k.share > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS screening_rows,
  ROUND(ex.screened * k.share) AS screened, ROUND(ex.raised * k.share) AS raised,
  ROUND(ex.linked * k.share) AS linked, ROUND(ex.diagnosed * k.share) AS diagnosed,
  trt.registered, trt.under_care, trt.controlled
FROM m CROSS JOIN ex CROSS JOIN trt CROSS JOIN k
WHERE '${isAllowed}' = '1'

spec.description: Screening cascade: adults screened this year, from eligible to newly diagnosed with hypertension. Each percent above a bar is a share of the first bar. The grey line under a bar is the share of the step before it. Steps 1 to 3 come from CKG. Newly diagnosed counts new I10 registrations in puskesmas EHR data, a different system, so that bar has no step rate. Targets are for the full year. Treatment cascade: estimated adults with hypertension, then registered, under care and BP controlled. Each percent is a share of the estimate. Under care means at least one visit in the last 12 months. BP controlled means below 140/90 at the last visit. Both charts use the location you picked and the latest completed month. Population, prevalence and screening counts are example data, not program data.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT * FROM (
WITH quarters AS (
  SELECT generate_series(
    date_trunc('quarter', $__timeFrom()::timestamp),
    date_trunc('quarter', $__timeTo()::timestamp),
    interval '3 months'
  )::date AS q
),
counts AS (
  SELECT
    q.q,
    COUNT(c.org_unit_id) AS total,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.status_at_end_of_interval = 'controlled' THEN 1 END), 0) AS controlled,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.status_at_end_of_interval = 'uncontrolled' THEN 1 END), 0) AS uncontrolled,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.status_at_end_of_interval = 'missed visit' THEN 1 END), 0) AS no_visit
  FROM quarters q
  LEFT JOIN HEART360_COHORT_PATIENT_DETAILS c
    ON c.registration_quarter = q.q
    AND c.org_unit_id IN (SELECT id FROM org_units
  WHERE NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0') IS NULL
  UNION
  SELECT id FROM get_descendant_ids(
    (SELECT ou.id FROM org_units ou
     WHERE ou.id::text = NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM '${org_unit}'), ''), '0')
     LIMIT 1)
  ))
  WHERE q.q + interval '6 months'
    <= date_trunc('month', to_timestamp(${reference_month}/1000.0)) + interval '1 month'
  GROUP BY q.q
)
SELECT
  'Q' || EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM q)::int || '-' || EXTRACT(YEAR FROM q)::int || ' cohort' AS cohort_label,
  to_char(total, 'FM999,999,999') || CASE WHEN total = 1 THEN ' patient' ELSE ' patients' END AS patients_label,
  'Q' || EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM q + interval '3 months')::int || '-'
    || EXTRACT(YEAR FROM q + interval '3 months')::int AS result_quarter,
  ROUND(100.0 * controlled / NULLIF(total, 0), 2) AS controlled_h,
  ROUND(100.0 * uncontrolled / NULLIF(total, 0), 2) AS uncontrolled_h,
  ROUND(100.0 * no_visit / NULLIF(total, 0), 2) AS no_visit_h,
  CASE WHEN total > 0 AND 100.0 * controlled / total >= 5
       THEN ROUND(100.0 * controlled / total)::int || '%' ELSE '' END AS controlled_lbl,
  CASE WHEN total > 0 AND 100.0 * uncontrolled / total >= 5
       THEN ROUND(100.0 * uncontrolled / total)::int || '%' ELSE '' END AS uncontrolled_lbl,
  CASE WHEN total > 0 AND 100.0 * no_visit / total >= 5
       THEN ROUND(100.0 * no_visit / total)::int || '%' ELSE '' END AS no_visit_lbl,
  to_char(controlled, 'FM999,999,999') AS controlled_n,
  to_char(uncontrolled, 'FM999,999,999') AS uncontrolled_n,
  to_char(no_visit, 'FM999,999,999') AS no_visit_n
FROM counts
ORDER BY q
) AS master_access_control WHERE '${isAllowed}' = '1'

spec.definition:
-- Locations the current user may view, from their Grafana teams (id 0 = All Locations).
-- can_view_patients: an admin or a patients team grants it; aggregated teams give dashboards only.
-- Team names (<type> = patients | aggregated, <location> = lowercased name, spaces -> _):
--   heart360tk_view_<type>_<location>          location and below; nothing if the name is not unique
--   heart360tk_view_<type>_ALL                 everything
--   heart360tk_<level>_view_<type>_<location>  legacy: location at that level and below
--   heart360tk_<level>_view_<type>_ALL         legacy: every location at that level and below
-- All Locations (0) needs nationwide access: admin, a new _ALL team, or a level-1 legacy _ALL team.
WITH my_teams AS (
  SELECT t.name, ty.type
  FROM grafana_schema.team_member tm
  JOIN grafana_schema.team t ON t.id = tm.team_id
  CROSS JOIN (VALUES ('patients'), ('aggregated')) AS ty(type)
  WHERE tm.user_id = ${__user.id}
),
slugs AS (
  SELECT ou.id, ou.level, replace(lower(trim(ou.name)), ' ', '_') AS slug
  FROM heart360tk_schema.org_units ou
),
all_access AS (
  SELECT 0 AS level, true AS patients
  FROM grafana_schema."user" u
  WHERE u.id = ${__user.id} AND u.is_admin
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 0, mt.type = 'patients'
  FROM my_teams mt
  WHERE mt.name = 'heart360tk_view_' || mt.type || '_ALL'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT hc.level, mt.type = 'patients'
  FROM my_teams mt
  JOIN heart360tk_schema.hierarchy_config hc
    ON mt.name = 'heart360tk_' || hc.var_name || '_view_' || mt.type || '_ALL'
),
granted AS (
  SELECT MIN(s.id) AS id, mt.type = 'patients' AS patients
  FROM my_teams mt
  JOIN slugs s ON mt.name = 'heart360tk_view_' || mt.type || '_' || s.slug
  GROUP BY mt.name, mt.type
  HAVING COUNT(*) = 1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT s.id, mt.type = 'patients'
  FROM my_teams mt
  JOIN slugs s ON true
  LEFT JOIN heart360tk_schema.hierarchy_config hc ON hc.level = s.level
  WHERE mt.name = 'heart360tk_' || COALESCE(hc.var_name, 'level_' || s.level) || '_view_' || mt.type || '_' || s.slug
),
access AS (
  SELECT x.id, bool_or(x.patients) AS can_view_patients
  FROM (
    SELECT 0 AS id, aa.patients FROM all_access aa WHERE aa.level <= 1
    UNION ALL
    SELECT s.id, aa.patients FROM slugs s JOIN all_access aa ON s.level >= aa.level
    UNION ALL
    SELECT lin.org_unit_id, g.patients
    FROM heart360tk_schema.org_unit_lineage lin
    JOIN granted g ON g.id = lin.ancestor_id
  ) x
  GROUP BY x.id
)
SELECT COALESCE(string_agg(a.id || ':' || CASE WHEN a.can_view_patients THEN '1' ELSE '0' END, ',' ORDER BY a.id), '') AS user_access
FROM access a
